title: Hs for large LEO constellations — total systems coherence, fleet navigation & dual-use sensing (technical spec)
status: SEED / concept + technical specification. No orbital-data run yet.
author: Peter Higgins (human authorship for all claims); AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001.
honest_broker: Tiered throughout. T1 = measured P1 engine facts only. T2 = reasoned mappings + established methods. T3 = every operational/scientific magnitude (NO numbers asserted). T3+ = embedded controller / deployment. The actuation-authority gate (below) is a REQUIREMENT, not an option.
human_gate: Peter Higgins is the sole gate. No AI commits/pushes/contacts. No engagement with SpaceX or any party is implied or authorized.
core_principles: Determinism + full provenance (content hash at every layer).
Recursive linear-algebraic structure (ILR + quaternion/SO(3) + Laplacian + linear spectral bases).
Locked coherence at scale and distance = the same linear algebra applied self-similarly with a receipt at each level.
Controller AND analyzer in lock-step -- BUT analysis<->recommendation is locked; actuation authority stays GATED (observe-or-control fork preserved; guard layers active).
Dual-use: operations + planetary science from one read; the residual is the science.
Complement, never replacement, for propagators / conjunction assessment / GNSS estimators.

safety_boundary.requirement: Hs provides deterministic, auditable control-DECISION SUPPORT with hard guard rails and a content receipt; a qualified-automation tier or a human holds ACTUATION authority. Especially binding for collision avoidance (safety-of-life).
safety_boundary.rationale: Preserves the P3 guard layer and the observe-or-control doctrine under the controller/analyzer unification.

fleet_coherence_index.formula: FCI = w1*C_geo + w2*C_behav + w3*C_kin + w4*C_spec + w5*(1 - R_risk)
fleet_coherence_index.tier: T2 structure / T3 every value, dynamic range, and lead-time

C_geo.reads: relative position/velocity consistency vs reference geometry

C_behav.method: Activation Coefficient + Helmsman on (often proprietary) effort proxies

C_kin.method: noise-bounded derivatives + curvature (P4) on orbital elements

C_spec.reads: frequency-content consistency + coherent response to F10.7/Kp
C_spec.method: Lomb-Scargle / wavelet-packet features aggregated across fleet

fleet_coherence_index.weights: w_i >= 0, sum = 1; tunable per shell/phase/solar-activity; UNTUNED = research object, not an operational signal.
fleet_coherence_index.receipt: SHA-256 over {fci, sub-metrics, hash(states), hash(reference_geometry), weights}, full-precision, sort_keys, UTF-8.

signal_separation.key_point: NOT blind source separation -- the operator knows its own commanded control; subtract it, residual = environment + noise; then Hs MC-4 attributes the residual across environmental carriers. Cleaner control record => cleaner science residual.
signal_separation.method: forward-model + subtract known (commanded control, relativity, Sagnac, gravity field) -> residual -> MC-4 carrier attribution

spectral_wavelet.lomb_scargle: stable frequency ID on unevenly-sampled data

wavelet_packet.best_basis: Shannon-entropy cost (Coifman-Wickerhauser, deterministic with fixed wavelet+cost)

spectral_wavelet.wavelet_coherence: between residual and external driver (F10.7/Kp) or neighbours, to separate driven response from anomaly

F10_7.is: 10.7 cm solar radio flux, proxy for solar EUV

Kp.use: storm context, adaptive thresholds, coherence reference

facts.GPS_MEO: ~+45.7 us/day GR, ~-7.2 us/day SR, NET ~+38 us/day FAST (~20,200 km, ~3.9 km/s)
facts.crossover_altitude_km: ~3200 (SR and GR cancel for circular orbit)
facts.LEO_starlink: ~550 km is BELOW crossover -> velocity (SR) term dominates -> clocks run SLOW (NET NEGATIVE, opposite sign to GPS; ISS at ~400 km ~ -25 to -28 us/day). Exact value altitude/velocity specific.
facts.sagnac: geometric frame-rotation correction for one/two-way time transfer + inter-satellite ranging; EXACTLY computed and applied -- a correction, NOT noise to mitigate.

relativistic_timing.hs_role: operate on POST-correction residuals only; fold timing coherence into FCI; over long records test residual<->environment correlation. Hs does NOT replace or improve the relativistic/Sagnac physics.

tx_rx_chain.representation: radio metrics as additional ILR compositional channels alongside orbital state + environment
tx_rx_chain.control_use: ADVISORY adaptive modulation/power/routing; Hs is the slower high-fidelity layer; hard real-time control + actuation stay separate (safety_boundary).

architecture.recursion: local 4-part exact charts -> overlapping atlas (linear SU(2) transition maps) -> balanced-tree Laplacian roll-up (O(log D) diameter) -> fleet metrics -> (optionally) constellation-of-constellations. Same linear algebra + a receipt at every level.
architecture.data_flow: raw tracking (+radio) -> detrend (F10.7/Kp, commanded control, relativity, Sagnac) -> features (kinematics + wavelet) -> ILR compositional representation -> coherence/anomaly -> hash-receipted outputs

dual_use_science.neutral_atmosphere: density, winds, gravity waves from drag residuals (needs high-precision ephemerides + ballistic coefficients).
dual_use_science.ionosphere: plasma irregularities / scintillation from radio metrics (needs proprietary high-rate link data); TEC as the error-is-the-science product.
dual_use_science.method: the residual is the science: remove exactly-known physics -> study what remains -> refine models over a solar cycle -> models improve operations -> cleaner data -> better science (continuous, standard-operations by-product).

public_sufficient_for: FCI behaviour + storm-response tests (Starlink TLEs + F10.7 + Kp)
needs_proprietary: fine science (winds, gravity waves, density retrieval): high-precision ephemerides + ballistic coefficients
ionospheric scintillation: high-rate radio link metrics
data_and_precision.rule: always state which precision channel a result came from; never present a TLE-precision result as a high-precision science product.

roadmap.phase_0: 3-6 mo: finalize FCI spec, fix LEO bands/wavelet scales, stand up public data pipelines.
roadmap.phase_1: 6-12 mo: minimal FCI + spectral-anomaly prototype on PUBLIC data; validate across a known geomagnetic storm; kinematics drag proxy vs a standard atmospheric model.
roadmap.phase_2: 12-24 mo: advisory dashboards; internal science products (safety boundary held).
roadmap.phase_3: 24+ mo: full-constellation scale; external science collaboration; long-term model refinement.
roadmap.promotion_rule: only measured prototype output with a content receipt may leave Tier 3.

open_questions: Does the FCI move AHEAD of per-pair conjunction probability in real events?
Can a kinematics drag proxy beat/complement a standard atmospheric model during a storm?
What OD precision is the floor for each science product, and is it reachable from any public source?
Where is the real Delta-v lever (earlier detection vs coordination vs false-positive reduction) against real station-keeping logs?
generalization_note: The pattern (compositional state + recursive coherence + multi-scale analysis + receipted determinism + guard) is domain-general -- space debris/STM (closest), V2X / cooperative perception, distributed + underwater acoustics, returning to Hs's acoustic origin (HCI-ULTRASOUND). Captured separately and tiered as HORIZON in GENERALIZATION_AND_ACOUSTIC_RETURN.md; the constellation remains the focused flagship. Each other domain is its own unvalidated hypothesis.
